task.title: Fix the four independently reproduced structural output boundary defects (T24 F-001..F-004)
task.description: Make the existing RED regressions GREEN and fix production for all four T24 blockers: F-001 recognized secret/PII span inside an enumerable JSON property name must return format-unsafe (never rename the key, never leak it); F-002 validateSerializedOutput must not restore original serialized bytes unless the original text also passes the deterministic text floor unchanged (duplicate JSON members), same rule in src/mcp/redact-seam.ts; F-003 a local $ref with supported validation siblings must either enforce the siblings after the referenced schema or fail closed as format-unsafe with reason schema.unsupported-reference-siblings; F-004 HTML character references in img src and every srcset candidate must be classified as auto-fetch exfil while an ordinary public Markdown link stays unchanged. Six RED tests already exist (4 in output-validation.test.ts / 2 in exfil.test.ts); confirm they fail first, write a short spec artifact, fix, then run the focused security suite, targeted ESLint and bun run typecheck. Write T26-spec.md, T26-implementation.md and T26-result.json into the flow artifacts dir. Do not review your own fix.

acceptance_criteria: AC2 (AFC-02): synthetic secret is absent from JSON, text resource and error; safe JSON passes its schema; a numeric required field carrying a secret is not replaced by an invalid string (format-unsafe instead).
AC5 (AFC-15): a mixed corpus of safe IDs and real secrets allows no field-name bypass; a URL secret is masked; a public Markdown link is not treated as a network send.

T24 F-001..F-004 are each closed by a regression that fails before and passes after the fix; the existing 78 focused security/MCP tests stay green; no reason token or failure text contains the rejected value, a raw secret, or a fingerprint.
constraints: Root /Users/Goodea/goodea/keryx. Read .metaproject/index.md first, then .metaproject/skills/gdskills/orchestration/task-implementer/SKILL.md and .metaproject/rules/core/tdd-workflow.mdc. Code search only via bun src/cli.ts ctx rg; long outputs via bun src/cli.ts ctx run.

Ownership: src/security/output-validation.ts + .test.ts, src/security/schemas.ts (only $ref/sibling handling and screenSchema), src/security/detect/exfil.ts + .test.ts, src/mcp/redact-seam.ts, and ONLY the validateSerializedOutput helper region at the top of src/security/service.ts. Do NOT touch runGate/scan/redact code in service.ts, src/security/guard.ts, src/security/path-scan.ts, src/mcp/dispatch.ts, flow files, package.json, lockfile.
No git commands that change state, no network, no model calls, no global test suite, no dependency changes. Synthetic fixtures only; never embed a real credential. Stats disabled.
Do not delete or weaken existing tests; keep the T19 approved contract (constant format-unsafe text, fixed reason tokens, undefined member => format-unsafe).
Return a subagent-result JSON at the artifact_path and reply with STATUS: line first.
